items.title: For a Koszul regular ideal the Ext algebra of the quotient is the exterior algebra on its first Ext sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: For a ringed space Y with a sheaf of ideals I, quotient O_X = O_Y/I, the lemma asserts that if I is Koszul regular in the sense of Divisors, Definition labelled divisors-definition-regular-ideal-sheaf, then composition on RSheafHom_{O_Y}(O_X, O_X) induces isomorphisms wedge^i(SheafExt^1(O_X, O_X)) -> SheafExt^i(O_X, O_X) for all i (statement lines 3660-3674). The proof first recalls that composition is the map of Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-internal-hom-composition, which induces multiplication maps SheafExt^a otimes SheafExt^b -> SheafExt^{a+b} to be compared with More on Algebra, Equation labelled more-algebra-equation-simple-tor-product, so the assertion is that the multiplication map from the i-fold tensor power of SheafExt^1 factors through the wedge product and then is an isomorphism (proof lines 3676-3696). Working locally, one takes global sections f_1, ..., f_r generating I and forming a Koszul regular sequence, forms the strictly commutative differential graded algebra A = O_Y<xi_1, ..., xi_r> which is a divided power polynomial algebra on generators in degree -1 with d xi_i = f_i, and notes that the canonical map A^bullet -> O_X is a quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 3698-3712). Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-Rhom-strictly-perfect then gives quasi-isomorphisms RSheafHom(O_X, O_X) -> SheafHom^bullet(A^bullet, A^bullet) -> SheafHom^bullet(A^bullet, O_X) whose differentials vanish, so SheafExt^i is SheafHom_{O_Y}(A^{-i}, O_X) (proof lines 3714-3726). For each j the derivation delta_j of degree 1 with delta_j(xi_i) = the Kronecker delta satisfies delta_j o d = -d o delta_j, hence defines a section of the corresponding Ext sheaf; the proof states that a computation shows delta_1, ..., delta_r map to a basis of SheafHom(A^{-1}, O_X) over O_X, and since delta_j o delta_j = 0 and delta_j o delta_{j'} = -delta_{j'} o delta_j the map factors through the exterior power, while the elements delta_{j_1} o ... o delta_{j_i} for increasing indices are checked to map to a basis of SheafHom(A^{-i}, O_X) over O_X, which gives the isomorphism (proof lines 3728-3758). Recognising the Ext algebra of a Koszul regular quotient as the derived Hom of the Koszul dga and reading the exterior algebra structure off the derivations is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
